description.value: Milos Greek Taverna is a full-service Greek restaurant on the Esplanade in Harrison Hot Springs, overlooking the lake with seating on a second-floor deck. It is known for generous portions of roasted lamb, calamari, and ribs, and has earned a 4.2-star rating from over 630 Google reviews. Touring cyclists passing through Harrison Hot Springs will find a sit-down meal with a scenic lakeside setting and online reservation options.
